desc: Ideation: monotonicity of cur; Fenwick approach — range add on cur = point updates on difference array d; boundaries via BIT binary lifting (lower_bound on prefix sums); O((N+V) log V + Q).
Implement fast input parsing (sys.stdin.buffer.read + split) and read N, pairs (L_i, R_i), Q, queries.
Build BIT over d[1..V] (V=5·10^5) initialized with d[i]=1 via bit[i] = i & -i.
Implement BIT lower_bound via binary lifting; a = lower_bound(L_i)+1, b = lower_bound(R_i+1); guards for a>V, b=0, a>b.
Range update: bit.add(a,+1); if b<V: bit.add(b+1,-1).
Reconstruct d from BIT in O(V) (reverse loop), prefix-sum in place so bit[x]=cur[x]; answer queries with bit[X].
Verify against all three samples and edge cases (N=1, X=1, X=5·10^5, no-op contests, full-range contests, b=V, a>V) before finalizing.
